name: Spike Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Spike Solitaire is a card game with a detective theme! There is nothing like a theme to spruce up a solitaire game. The detective in this game is searching for some clues, while you are searching for the cards you will need. The cards and backgrounds are shrouded in the mystery theme but the objective of this online card game remains the same. There are 3 levels in this solitaire game, and each one is timed. You must solve each game before the timer runs out! Once you have solved all 3 levels, your final score will be automatically submitted. Check the scoreboard to see if you are one of the top card players!
